Prospective Observational Study Planning Outline

Use with your mentor to develop a feasible study. This is an educational planning aid, not an approved IRB protocol or a substitute for current institutional templates.

Click a shaded field to replace its prompt. Edits stay in this page only and reset on refresh. Use Print / Save as PDF to retain your work. Use nonconfidential planning text.

· Project Examples Library

Question and Design

[Population, observational exposure or characteristic, comparison, primary outcome, and rationale. Identify what care remains outside study assignment.]

Recruitment and Eligibility

[Setting; sampling frame; inclusion/exclusion; recruitment approach; realistic eligible population; anticipated recruitment and loss to follow-up.]

Measurements and Follow-Up

[Visit schedule, measures/instruments, timing, definitions, quality control, participant burden, and handling of missed visits.]

Feasibility

[Justified sample and precision; team time; recruitment access; budget; data collection system; achievable timeline.]

Analysis Plan

[Primary comparison/estimand, confounding and repeated measures as applicable, missing data, attrition, and prespecified sensitivity analyses.]

Participant Protection

[Consent process, privacy, risks of study procedures, risk mitigation, and reporting/monitoring appropriate to the actual study. Obtain institutional guidance.]

Interpretation and Submission

[What can be concluded despite confounding, selection and follow-up limitations? Use the current official LSU Health Observational Study template.]
